name: Chained pair
description: a small scrawny demon whelp of the Cracked Road wearing an iron collar from which a thick chain trails off to its right, tugging at it

poses.stand: standing on all fours, collar and chain taut to the right, snarling, facing right
poses.struck: struck: yanked back by the chain, yelping
poses.dead: lying limp, the chain snapped and coiled beside it

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
